text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel got injured, so I brought 
her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for making you worry. But I'm 
completely fine now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
There's no pain either, so let's get back 
to training.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I don't intend to overdo it! I 
plan to see how it goes, starting with 
lighter training than usual."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
choice_data_list: Let's play it safe and rest up.
Stop immediately if you feel any pain.

text_block_list.text:
I told Sakura Laurel that we cannot take 
the risk of worsening her injury lightly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Better safe than sorry... right? 
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I'll take it easy and rest today.

Sakura Laurel got some rest to dedicate 
herself to recovery.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ah... Excuse me, it hurts a little...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I really will take it easy and make sure 
to heal my injury properly.

It seems Sakura Laurel's injury has 
worsened...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah! If it's this light, it should be 
fine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Keeping up this pace, I'll tackle all the 
training I can do!

Sakura Laurel kept her training gentle and 
reasonable, being mindful of her injury.
